text:
maria: deploybot blocked the canary for release v1.4.3-shim — seeing ~5% 503s on embeddings in eu-west1 after last night's kernel update. requesting expedited override to push a hotpatch that reverts the kernel gating change. @sre-oncall can you ack?

deploy-bot: Release v1.4.3-shim - Canary failed (latency>200ms threshold). To override, need explicit approvals from 2 engineers + release-manager. CI: green. Rolling image: redwood/serving:patch-20260320

tom: can you paste the failing metric? how long has this been up?
maria: started ~25m ago after the night build, error rate peaked at 4.8% 503s for /v1/embeddings around 22:10 UTC. graphs: https://grafana.example.com/d/abc123

lev: what's rollback criteria if we push? we should require immediate rollback if 503 > 1% for 5m

maria: agreed. rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/serving redwood=redwood/serving:stable-20260319 && kubectl rollout status deploy/serving`

sre-oncall: ack @maria. I saw a similar regression in staging earlier. I can monitor EU nodes for 30m. If we see >1% 503 sustained for 5m I will trigger rollback.

tom: +1 to override. quick sanity: the patch disables a quant kernel optimization, TPU path unaffected.

devops: +1. we'll pin canary to 5% for 3m then bump to 25% if healthy.

release-manager: i'm oncall for release approvals. confirm release note and customer-facing blurb? need a short line about temporary revert of kernel gating.

maria: release note draft: "Temporary revert of kernel gating to mitigate intermittent 503s for embeddings. No model changes. Monitoring in place; rollback plan ready."

release-manager: approved. @deploy-bot proceed with override at 1733333400
deploy-bot: Override authorized by 3 approvers (tom, devops, release-manager) + ack from @sre-oncall. Initiating canary at 5% now.

deploy-bot: Canary update: 5% injected. health checks passing for 2m. next bump scheduled at +10m if no regressions.

sre-oncall: monitoring: latency normalizing, 503s down to 0.6%—holding.

maria: thanks team. follow-ups: create quick incident note, assign postmortem if recurrence.

tom: filing a short postmortem ticket now: https://jira.example.com/browse/PROD-789

release-manager: mark as expedited hotpatch in release log. closing thread once 60m stable.

maria: consensus to close if 60m stable. :thumbsup:
